product.name: 1212.Stable
product.standfirst: Capital preservation first. Passive income generated from stablecoin-denominated assets with transparent, verifiable collateral, and no direct exposure to crypto market volatility.

description: The strategy prioritizes capital preservation. It is designed to generate passive income through stablecoin-denominated assets, eliminating direct exposure to crypto market volatility. Deployments focus on stablecoins with transparent and verifiable collateral, using liquidity provision, arbitrage mechanisms, and on-chain fixed-income strategies to produce stable and risk-controlled yield.
